correctness.rationale: For each proper tube of size s, direct simplex support gives L_s=sum_{l<=s}(s-l+1)w_l and M_s=T-L_{n-s}. At uniform center the exact margins are D_s=sum_{l=2}^{n-1}w_l min(s,l-1)+s w_n/n and U_s=sum_{l=2}^{n-1}w_l min(n-s,l-1)+(n-s)w_n/n. Termwise D_s>=D_1 and U_s<=U_1 with both strict for s>1 because w_n>0. The known tube-facet H-description ensures all reflected containment conditions are tested. Summing n singleton inequalities gives lambda>=U_1/D_1 for arbitrary center; equality forces all center coordinates equal. The weighted-average range and unit-weight simplification follow exactly. Standalone verifier passed 20 integral profiles, 440 tube extrema tests, 5088 distinct enumerated vertices, and independent linear programming optima; those finite checks are explicitly not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete affine invariant and center classification for every cyclic-cardinality-positive weighted nestohedron, a natural deformation family of the cyclohedron. The formula reduces an exponentially structured collection of potential subset constraints to singleton tubes and identifies a nontrivial weighted average of length offsets, sharp full range (1,n-1), uniform center uniqueness, and the exact unweighted asymptotic n/2. The weight dependence and all-size theorem go beyond a one-off numerical example, routine scale change, or an unmotivated finite slice.
